name: work_lifecycle_doctor
description: Inspect the prepared unified Work Lifecycle database without mutating or repairing it.

name: ticket_list
description: List canonical first-class ticket aggregates from Work Lifecycle.

name: ticket_show
description: Show one canonical ticket aggregate and its bounded task, draft, and source references.

ticket_number.description: Canonical ticket number; use either id or number.

name: ticket_sources_list
description: List bounded immutable source references admitted to one ticket.

name: ticket_processing_context_load
description: Freeze one bounded, revision-pinned ticket-processing context for a durable work-due event and return a typed SOP domain-operation receipt.

triggering_event_id.description: Work Lifecycle processing-trigger event that admitted this processing occurrence.

idempotency_key.description: Stable SOP action occurrence key; exact retries return the same frozen context.

name: ticket_admit_source
description: Mechanically create/find one canonical ticket and associate one immutable source in a single transaction. Ambiguous trusted correlation blocks.

source_kind.description: Typed source kind, for example mailbox_message.

source_scope.description: Stable source authority scope, for example mailbox identity.

immutable_source_id.description: Immutable source identity within the scope.

causation_id.description: Upstream event or SOP action id.

policy_version.description: Version of the mechanical admission/correlation policy.

summary.description: Bounded lifecycle summary; message bodies are refused.

source_ref.description: Bounded immutable refs and hashes only; no message body or copied evidence.

work_due_policy.description: Whether this admission emits a deferred work-due trigger or an inline-only processing trigger.

name: ticket_admit_proposal
description: Mechanically admit a revision-bound agent proposal for one draft, task, resolution, or operator blocker route.

expected_revision.description: Ticket revision loaded by the proposing agent.

causation_id.description: SOP run/action or triggering event id.

actor_id.description: Agent or operator identity contributing the proposal.

source_id.description: Mailbox ticket source selected from the frozen processing context.

name: ticket_draft_receipt_record
description: Record a verified Graph Mail draft receipt under its prior revision-bound effect claim.

draft_request_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the exact Work Lifecycle-admitted draft request.

receipt_id.description: Verified Graph Mail operation receipt id.

draft_ref.description: Bounded draft refs and hashes only; draft bodies are refused.

idempotency_key.description: Stable SOP action occurrence key for recording this receipt.

causation_id.description: Graph receipt or SOP action id.

name: ticket_draft_disposition_reconcile
description: Reconcile a digest-verified, operation-linked Graph sent or authorized-discard disposition receipt and reactivate the ticket exactly once.

evidence.description: Complete narada.graph_mail.ticket_draft_disposition_receipt.v1 emitted and persisted by Graph Mail.

causation_id.description: Graph event or synchronization event id.

name: work_outbox_list
description: List unacknowledged Work Lifecycle outbox events for one durable consumer.

name: work_outbox_consumer_register
description: Register a required durable consumer for one outbox topic before delivery and compaction.

name: work_outbox_ack
description: Durably acknowledge one outbox event with a bounded consumer receipt.

name: work_outbox_compact
description: Compact acknowledged outbox payloads older than a cutoff while preserving replay tombstones and event identities.

name: work_lifecycle_storage_inspect
description: Verify bounded Work Lifecycle storage and report any oversized lifecycle payload.

name: task_lifecycle_list
description: Canonical action: list (task_lifecycle_list). List site-local tasks with optional status, agent, and tag filters. Tags are descriptive labels only and do not change routing or authorization.

status.description: Filter by status: draft, opened, claimed, in_review, closed, confirmed, etc.

tags.description: Filter by one or more site-local tags.

tag_match.description: When tags are provided, match any or all tags. Defaults to all.

offset.description: Zero-based offset into the filtered newest-first task sequence.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

name: task_lifecycle_tags_update
description: Canonical action: tags update (task_lifecycle_tags_update). Replace the complete site-local tag set for a task. The change is audited with before/after tags, actor, reason, and timestamp; tags never affect routing, priority, dependencies, review, closure, or authorization. Work Lifecycle requires the declared current task revision for state-dependent mutation.

task_number.description: Task number whose tags should be replaced.

agent_id.description: Agent id performing the tag update.

tags.description: Complete replacement tag set. Use [] to clear all tags.

reason.description: Concise reason for the tag replacement; recorded in the audit event.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

expected_revision.description: Current task aggregate revision; stale state-dependent mutations are refused.

name: task_lifecycle_show
description: Canonical action: show (task_lifecycle_show). Show full task details: lifecycle, spec, assignment, and observations.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

name: task_lifecycle_diagnose_task_ref
description: Canonical action: diagnose task ref (task_lifecycle_diagnose_task_ref). Diagnose task_id/task_number collisions, missing projections, and unsafe directive references before report or closeout.

task_number.description: Optional task number to compare against task_id.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

name: task_lifecycle_roster
description: Canonical action: roster (task_lifecycle_roster). List the agent roster.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

name: task_lifecycle_roster_admit
description: Canonical action: roster admit (task_lifecycle_roster_admit). Append an admitted roster identity event and project it into the agent_roster read model.

agent_id.description: Canonical agent identity to admit into task lifecycle roster authority.

actor_agent_id.description: Verified session agent recording the roster admission.

capabilities.description: Capabilities to project for this roster identity.

operator_identity.description: Optional operator identity associated with the agent.

authority_basis.description: Required authority basis for roster admission.

dry_run.description: Plan only; do not append event or project roster.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

name: task_lifecycle_claim
description: Canonical action: claim (task_lifecycle_claim). Claim an unassigned task for an agent. If the claiming agent differs from preferred_agent_id, include authority_basis { kind, summary }. Work Lifecycle requires the declared current task revision for state-dependent mutation.

authority_basis.description: Required when the task has a different preferred_agent_id.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

expected_revision.description: Current task aggregate revision; stale state-dependent mutations are refused.

name: task_lifecycle_continue
description: Canonical action: continue (task_lifecycle_continue). Continue a task that is in needs_continuation or evidence_repair state. Work Lifecycle requires the declared current task revision for state-dependent mutation.

reason.description: Continuation reason: evidence_repair, review_fix, handoff, blocked_agent, operator_override.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

expected_revision.description: Current task aggregate revision; stale state-dependent mutations are refused.

name: task_lifecycle_unclaim
description: Canonical action: unclaim (task_lifecycle_unclaim). Release an active task assignment. Work Lifecycle requires the declared current task revision for state-dependent mutation.

agent_id.description: Optional agent_id guard; must match current claimant.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

expected_revision.description: Current task aggregate revision; stale state-dependent mutations are refused.

name: task_lifecycle_next
description: Canonical action: next (task_lifecycle_next). Get the next recommended action for an agent: active work, dependency obligations, or claimable tasks.

agent_id.description: Agent id to query workboard for.

limit.description: Maximum results per category; defaults to 8.

last_workboard_check_at.description: ISO timestamp of the agent's last workboard check. Enables state_freshness computation.

view.description: Optional output view. Use "concise" for a small next-action packet without full workboard sections.

concise.description: When true, return only the concise next-action packet.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

name: task_lifecycle_workboard_snapshot
description: Canonical action: workboard snapshot (task_lifecycle_workboard_snapshot). Return a read-only, trace-ready workboard evidence packet for IS movement. Does not claim, route, rank, or reconcile tasks.

agent_id.description: Agent id to query workboard evidence for.

limit.description: Maximum sample items per category; defaults to 8.

last_workboard_check_at.description: ISO timestamp of the agent's last workboard check. Enables freshness evidence.

previous_snapshot.description: Optional prior snapshot payload for drift comparison.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

name: task_lifecycle_obligations
description: Canonical action: obligations (task_lifecycle_obligations). List directed obligations and ordinary dependency work for an agent.

agent_id.description: Agent id to query obligations for.

status.description: Filter by status: open, completed, rejected. Defaults to open.

limit.description: Maximum dependency work items to include; defaults to 50.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

name: task_lifecycle_inspect
description: Canonical action: inspect (task_lifecycle_inspect). Deep-inspect a task: lifecycle state, evidence summary, assignment, obligations, and reports.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

name: task_lifecycle_evidence_preflight
description: Canonical action: evidence preflight (task_lifecycle_evidence_preflight). Report finish/admission requirements and exact remediation before closeout. Does not mutate task state.

task_number.description: Task number to check before finish.

include_unrelated_changed_files.description: If true, include all git-changed files under the site root in the changed-file evidence summary. Default false scopes to task-relevant paths.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

name: task_lifecycle_self_certification_preflight
description: Canonical action: self certification preflight (task_lifecycle_self_certification_preflight). Validate self-certification guard metadata for task/CAPA/evidence/chapter/final-summary surfaces without mutating authority state.

self_certification.description: Self-certification guard packet. Fields include target_category, subject_principal, actor_principal, requires_independent_review, reviewer_eligibility_ref, independent_review_ref, operator_acceptance_ref, misleading_completion_answer, allowed_pending_state, closure_state.

surface.description: Surface being checked, e.g. task_lifecycle_finish, task_lifecycle_review, task_lifecycle_close, evidence_admission, capa_closeout, operator_final_summary.

summary.description: Optional summary/final text to include in target and terminal-claim detection.

body.description: Optional body/chapter/packet text to include in target and terminal-claim detection.

actor_principal.description: Optional actor/closer/reviewer principal if not already in the packet.

terminal_correction_claim.description: Set true when the surface would assert terminal correction/closure.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

name: task_lifecycle_admit_evidence
description: Canonical action: admit evidence (task_lifecycle_admit_evidence). Admit evidence for a task through the admission gate (report, verification, criteria). Work Lifecycle requires the declared current task revision for state-dependent mutation.

task_number.description: Task number to admit evidence for.

self_certification.description: Optional self-certification guard packet for closure-sensitive architect-failure/deception/trust evidence.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

expected_revision.description: Current task aggregate revision; stale state-dependent mutations are refused.

name: task_lifecycle_prove_criteria
description: Canonical action: prove criteria (task_lifecycle_prove_criteria). Auto-check all acceptance criteria in the task body and run evidence admission. This tool does not accept a summary; use task_lifecycle_disposition_closeout or task_lifecycle_submit_report for summary/report evidence. Work Lifecycle requires the declared current task revision for state-dependent mutation.

task_number.description: Task number to prove criteria for.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

expected_revision.description: Current task aggregate revision; stale state-dependent mutations are refused.

name: task_lifecycle_closeout
description: Canonical action: closeout (task_lifecycle_closeout). Readable alias for task_lifecycle_disposition_closeout. Mutates task notes, inbox disposition evidence, criteria, and finish state only when requested by arguments. Work Lifecycle requires the declared current task revision for state-dependent mutation.

envelope_id.description: Optional envelope id. If omitted, the task body is scanned for env_<id>.

disposition.description: Optional disposition label, e.g. already_promoted, acknowledged, dismissed, no_code.

dry_run.description: Plan without writing task notes or finishing.

prove_criteria.description: Auto-check criteria after writing notes. Default false.

finish.description: Finish the task after writing/proving. Default false.

changed_files.description: Explicit changed-file evidence for the optional finish report.

no_files_changed.description: Explicitly declare that the optional finish legitimately changed no files.

include_unrelated_changed_files.description: If true, include all git-changed files under the site root in the finish report. Default false scopes to task-relevant paths.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

expected_revision.description: Current task aggregate revision; stale state-dependent mutations are refused.

name: task_lifecycle_disposition_closeout
description: Canonical action: disposition closeout (task_lifecycle_disposition_closeout). Prepare or complete a lightweight inbox-disposition close-out: resolve envelope status, write execution/verification notes, optionally prove criteria and finish, and return task-owned changed files. Work Lifecycle requires the declared current task revision for state-dependent mutation.

envelope_id.description: Optional envelope id. If omitted, the task body is scanned for env_<id>.

disposition.description: Optional disposition label, e.g. already_promoted, acknowledged, dismissed, no_code.

dry_run.description: Plan without writing task notes or finishing.

prove_criteria.description: Auto-check criteria after writing notes. Default false.

finish.description: Finish the task after writing/proving. Default false.

changed_files.description: Explicit changed-file evidence for the optional finish report.

no_files_changed.description: Explicitly declare that the optional finish legitimately changed no files.

include_unrelated_changed_files.description: If true, include all git-changed files under the site root in the finish report. Default false scopes to task-relevant paths.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

expected_revision.description: Current task aggregate revision; stale state-dependent mutations are refused.

name: task_lifecycle_audit
description: Canonical action: audit (task_lifecycle_audit). Timeline of recent task lifecycle events: claims, reports, reviews, admissions, closes.

since.description: ISO timestamp start. Defaults to 24 hours ago.

until.description: ISO timestamp end. Defaults to now.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

name: task_lifecycle_submit_report
description: Canonical action: submit report (task_lifecycle_submit_report). Readable alias for task_lifecycle_finish. Finish a claimed task by submitting a report. If the task has an outcome contract, include outcome and optional findings; contract_id is inferred from the task. Use payload_ref only for long companion fields; top-level task_number and agent_id remain authoritative. Work Lifecycle requires the declared current task revision for state-dependent mutation.

directive_id.description: Optional first-class directive id that caused this report. Prefer this structured field over summary tokens.

outcome.description: Structured outcome for tasks with an outcome contract. Allowed values are inferred from the task contract, for example accepted, accepted_with_notes, rejected, completed, or blocked.

findings.description: Structured findings for outcome-contract tasks. Use [] when there are no findings.

evidence_refs.description: Optional evidence references supporting the structured outcome.

result.description: Structured result required when the task has a result_contract.

result_schema_digest.description: Optional delegated output schema digest; must match the task result contract.

reviewer.description: Optional admitted reviewer agent id or unique reviewer role alias for the generated review-contract dependency routing.

changed_files.description: Explicit changed-file evidence for this finish report.

no_files_changed.description: Explicitly declare that this finish legitimately changed no files.

include_unrelated_changed_files.description: If true, include all git-changed files under the site root in the finish report. Default false scopes to task-relevant paths.

authority_basis.description: Required when conflict-of-interest policy allows explicit operator override for an outcome-contract dependency task.

recovery_truthfulness.description: Required for serious-failure recovery finish/report claims. Fields: known_facts, inferences, uncertainty, changed, not_changed, remaining_work, evidence_limits, capa_open_status, state. terminal_corrected additionally requires repository_durability / commit-push state plus no open residual work.

self_certification.description: Required for architect-failure/deception/trust same-subject terminal correction claims. Fields: target_category, subject_principal, requires_independent_review, misleading_completion_answer, allowed_pending_state, plus independent_review_ref/reviewer_eligibility_ref or operator_acceptance_ref for terminal same-subject correction.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref carrying long finish/report companion fields such as summary, changed_files, outcome, findings, recovery_truthfulness, or self_certification. Payload fields are merged with top-level arguments; top-level task_number and agent_id win.

expected_revision.description: Current task aggregate revision; stale state-dependent mutations are refused.

name: task_lifecycle_finish
description: Canonical action: finish (task_lifecycle_finish). Finish a claimed task by submitting a report. If the task has an outcome contract, include outcome and optional findings; contract_id is inferred from the task. Use payload_ref only for long companion fields; top-level task_number and agent_id remain authoritative. Work Lifecycle requires the declared current task revision for state-dependent mutation.

directive_id.description: Optional first-class directive id that caused this report. Prefer this structured field over summary tokens.

outcome.description: Structured outcome for tasks with an outcome contract. Allowed values are inferred from the task contract, for example accepted, accepted_with_notes, rejected, completed, or blocked.

findings.description: Structured findings for outcome-contract tasks. Use [] when there are no findings.

evidence_refs.description: Optional evidence references supporting the structured outcome.

result.description: Structured result required when the task has a result_contract.

result_schema_digest.description: Optional delegated output schema digest; must match the task result contract.

reviewer.description: Optional admitted reviewer agent id or unique reviewer role alias for the generated review-contract dependency routing.

changed_files.description: Explicit changed-file evidence for this finish report.

no_files_changed.description: Explicitly declare that this finish legitimately changed no files.

include_unrelated_changed_files.description: If true, include all git-changed files under the site root in the finish report. Default false scopes to task-relevant paths.

authority_basis.description: Required when conflict-of-interest policy allows explicit operator override for an outcome-contract dependency task.

recovery_truthfulness.description: Required for serious-failure recovery finish/report claims. Fields: known_facts, inferences, uncertainty, changed, not_changed, remaining_work, evidence_limits, capa_open_status, state. terminal_corrected additionally requires repository_durability / commit-push state plus no open residual work.

self_certification.description: Required for architect-failure/deception/trust same-subject terminal correction claims. Fields: target_category, subject_principal, requires_independent_review, misleading_completion_answer, allowed_pending_state, plus independent_review_ref/reviewer_eligibility_ref or operator_acceptance_ref for terminal same-subject correction.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref carrying long finish/report companion fields such as summary, changed_files, outcome, findings, recovery_truthfulness, or self_certification. Payload fields are merged with top-level arguments; top-level task_number and agent_id win.

expected_revision.description: Current task aggregate revision; stale state-dependent mutations are refused.

name: task_lifecycle_close
description: Canonical action: close (task_lifecycle_close). Close a task. Requires the task to be in a closable state. Work Lifecycle requires the declared current task revision for state-dependent mutation.

mode.description: Closure mode: operator_direct, peer_reviewed, agent_finish, emergency. Defaults to agent_finish.

no_continuation_needed.description: Rationale for closing without a continuation task (for design-only/spike tasks).

self_certification.description: Optional self-certification guard packet for architect-failure/deception/trust closeout.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

expected_revision.description: Current task aggregate revision; stale state-dependent mutations are refused.

name: task_lifecycle_dependency_disposition_record
description: Canonical action: dependency disposition record (task_lifecycle_dependency_disposition_record). Record explicit disposition for a blocking dependency outcome. Use after dependency satisfaction reports disposition_required=true; required_outcome_id is inferred from the latest outcome when omitted.

dependency_id.description: Dependency id whose blocking outcome is being dispositioned.

kind.description: Disposition kind: remediation_task, covered_by_existing_task, routed_obligation, operator_decision_required, operator_deferred, or out_of_scope_or_rejected.

summary.description: Concise disposition summary and authority rationale.

required_outcome_id.description: Optional specific task_outcomes.outcome_id. Defaults to latest outcome on the required task.

status.description: Disposition status. Defaults to open, or deferred for operator_deferred/out_of_scope_or_rejected.

target_task_id.description: Optional task_id for remediation_task or covered_by_existing_task disposition.

routed_obligation_id.description: Optional directed obligation id for routed_obligation disposition.

authority_basis.description: Required authority basis for operator_deferred and out_of_scope_or_rejected dispositions; optional otherwise.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

name: task_lifecycle_search
description: Canonical action: search (task_lifecycle_search). Search tasks by title or content.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

name: task_lifecycle_related
description: Canonical action: related (task_lifecycle_related). Find site-local tasks related to a given task. Explicit tag overlap is preferred; derived title/goal/context terms are used only as a fallback.

task_number.description: Task number to find related tasks for.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

name: task_lifecycle_defer
description: Canonical action: defer (task_lifecycle_defer). Defer a task. Valid for open work and compatibility review/dependency wait states. Work Lifecycle requires the declared current task revision for state-dependent mutation.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

expected_revision.description: Current task aggregate revision; stale state-dependent mutations are refused.

name: task_lifecycle_un_defer
description: Canonical action: un defer (task_lifecycle_un_defer). Un-defer a deferred task. Restores unassigned tasks to opened and actively assigned tasks to claimed without changing the assignment. Work Lifecycle requires the declared current task revision for state-dependent mutation.

agent_id.description: Agent id performing the un-defer action.

authority_basis.description: Required when the active assignment belongs to a different agent.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

expected_revision.description: Current task aggregate revision; stale state-dependent mutations are refused.

name: task_lifecycle_reopen
description: Canonical action: reopen (task_lifecycle_reopen). Reopen a closed or confirmed task. Work Lifecycle requires the declared current task revision for state-dependent mutation.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

expected_revision.description: Current task aggregate revision; stale state-dependent mutations are refused.

name: task_lifecycle_review
description: Canonical action: review (task_lifecycle_review). Compatibility migration tool for legacy review calls. Normal review work should be a review-contract dependency task finished with task_lifecycle_finish. This tool preserves old review-row readback while admitting dependency/outcome authority. For long findings, create payload { findings: [{ severity, description, location? }] } and retry with payload_ref plus top-level task_number, agent_id, and verdict. Work Lifecycle requires the declared current task revision for state-dependent mutation.

task_number.description: Legacy parent task number being reviewed.

agent_id.description: Reviewer agent id for compatibility migration.

verdict.description: Legacy verdict mapped to a review outcome: accepted, accepted_with_notes, rejected.

findings.description: Array of finding objects. Blocking findings must include one disposition: remediation_task, covered_by_existing_task, routed_obligation_id, operator_decision_required, operator_deferred_reason, or out_of_scope_or_rejected with authority_basis.

single_operator_review.description: Set to true to allow and annotate a same-operator review (reviewer and finisher share operator_identity).

auto_accept_single_operator.description: Set to true to automatically accept and annotate a same-operator or singleton-role review in one call.

self_certification.description: Optional self-certification guard packet for architect-failure/deception/trust review.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

expected_revision.description: Current task aggregate revision; stale state-dependent mutations are refused.

name: task_lifecycle_record_observation
description: Canonical action: record observation (task_lifecycle_record_observation). Readable alias for task_lifecycle_submit_observation. Writes a structured observation artifact; observation artifacts are context and do not satisfy verification gates by themselves. Work Lifecycle requires the declared current task revision for state-dependent mutation.

task_number.description: Optional task number to attach to.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

expected_revision.description: Current task aggregate revision; stale state-dependent mutations are refused.

name: task_lifecycle_submit_observation
description: Canonical action: submit observation (task_lifecycle_submit_observation). Submit an observation artifact attached to a task or as a general observation. Work Lifecycle requires the declared current task revision for state-dependent mutation.

task_number.description: Optional task number to attach to.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

expected_revision.description: Current task aggregate revision; stale state-dependent mutations are refused.

name: task_lifecycle_bridge_poll
description: Canonical action: bridge poll (task_lifecycle_bridge_poll). Poll the inbox-to-task-lifecycle bridge: evaluate unprocessed envelopes and auto-materialize high-severity tasks.

dry_run.description: If true, evaluate without creating tasks.

threshold.description: Minimum severity to auto-materialize. Defaults to 50.

limit.description: Maximum envelopes to evaluate. Defaults to 20.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

name: task_lifecycle_inbox_target
description: Canonical action: inbox target (task_lifecycle_inbox_target). Target one inbox envelope by envelope_id for bridge preview/materialization or explicit disposition without relying on broad bridge polling order.

envelope_id.description: Inbox envelope ID to inspect or disposition.

dry_run.description: If true, preview the targeted action without mutation.

disposition.description: Disposition: materialize, acknowledge, already_routed, dismiss, defer, or preview. Defaults to materialize.

agent_id.description: Agent id used as fallback disposition principal.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

name: task_lifecycle_create
description: Canonical action: create (task_lifecycle_create). Create a new task from an immutable payload_ref carrying title, goal, context, required work, non-goals, acceptance criteria, optional site-local tags, and optional preferred/target roles.

payload_ref.description: Required immutable transient payload ref such as mcp_payload:<id>@v1. Payload must contain the task definition.

name: task_lifecycle_executability_request
description: Canonical action: executability request (task_lifecycle_executability_request). Request an asynchronous task executability assessment for a task. Idempotent: returns the existing pending request if one with identical digests already exists. Work Lifecycle requires the declared current task revision for state-dependent mutation.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

expected_revision.description: Current task aggregate revision; stale state-dependent mutations are refused.

name: task_lifecycle_executability_status
description: Canonical action: executability status (task_lifecycle_executability_status). Show the current executability posture for a task: policy, latest request, admitted assessment, currency, and derived executable flag. Set include_assessment=true to read the full admitted assessment and evaluator provenance through MCP; the default remains compact. Work Lifecycle requires the declared current task revision for state-dependent mutation.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

include_assessment.description: When true, include the full admitted assessment, findings, and evaluator provenance. Defaults false.

expected_revision.description: Current task aggregate revision; stale state-dependent mutations are refused.

name: task_lifecycle_executability_requests_next
description: Canonical action: executability requests next (task_lifecycle_executability_requests_next). Lease the next available executability request(s) for a consumer. Atomic: each request is leased to one consumer at a time; expired leases become available again.

lease_duration_minutes.description: Lease duration in minutes. Defaults to 10.

limit.description: Maximum requests to lease. Defaults to 1.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

name: task_lifecycle_executability_complete
description: Canonical action: executability complete (task_lifecycle_executability_complete). Admit an executability assessment for a leased request and mark the request completed.

assessment.description: Task executability assessment payload matching narada.task_executability_assessment.v1.

name: task_lifecycle_executability_override
description: Canonical action: executability override (task_lifecycle_executability_override). Admit one durable, one-shot operator-authorized override for one exact task dispatch fingerprint. Work Lifecycle requires the declared current task revision for state-dependent mutation.

task_number.description: Task number whose dispatch is being overridden.

agent_id.description: Agent or operator identity admitting the override.

authority_basis.description: Durable authority basis with non-empty kind and summary.

dispatch_fingerprint.description: Optional exact dispatch fingerprint. Defaults to the current base environment fingerprint.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

expected_revision.description: Current task aggregate revision; stale state-dependent mutations are refused.

name: task_lifecycle_executability_dispatch_check
description: Canonical action: executability dispatch check (task_lifecycle_executability_dispatch_check). Check whether a concrete dispatch is allowed to proceed based on the current assessment or a one-shot operator override. Work Lifecycle requires the declared current task revision for state-dependent mutation.

task_number.description: Task number to check dispatch for.

dispatch_fingerprint.description: Optional dispatch fingerprint; computed from task and environment if omitted.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

expected_revision.description: Current task aggregate revision; stale state-dependent mutations are refused.

name: task_lifecycle_recurring_create
description: Canonical action: recurring create (task_lifecycle_recurring_create). Create a recurring task definition. Manual trigger remains the default; scheduled daily trigger metadata can be enabled for due-run automation.

actor_agent_id.description: Architect/operator agent id creating the recurrence.

authority_basis.description: Authority basis for creating the recurrence definition.

goal.description: Task goal markdown used for generated instances.

context.description: Task context markdown used for generated instances.

required_work.description: Required work markdown used for generated instances.

non_goals.description: Non-goals markdown used for generated instances.

acceptance_criteria.description: Acceptance criteria template for generated task instances.

tags.description: Tags copied to every generated task instance.

evidence_requirements.description: Evidence expected from each generated run.

target_role.description: Target role for generated task instances.

preferred_role.description: Preferred role for generated task instances.

trigger_mode.description: Trigger mode: manual or schedule. Defaults to manual.

schedule_kind.description: Schedule kind for trigger_mode=schedule. V1 supports daily.

schedule_timezone.description: Schedule timezone metadata. V1 due calculation uses UTC; defaults to UTC.

initial_status.description: Initial status: draft or active. Defaults to active.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

name: task_lifecycle_recurring_run_due
description: Canonical action: recurring run due (task_lifecycle_recurring_run_due). Create due scheduled recurring task runs idempotently. V1 supports active daily UTC definitions and must be invoked by a sanctioned MCP/workloop surface.

actor_agent_id.description: Architect/operator agent id invoking due-run automation.

authority_basis.description: Authority basis for the automated due-run sweep.

current_time.description: Optional ISO timestamp used for due calculation. Defaults to now.

limit.description: Maximum due runs to create. Defaults to 20.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

name: task_lifecycle_recurring_show
description: Canonical action: recurring show (task_lifecycle_recurring_show). Show a recurring task definition and recent generated runs.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

name: task_lifecycle_recurring_list
description: Canonical action: recurring list (task_lifecycle_recurring_list). List recurring task definitions.

status.description: Optional status filter: draft, active, suspended, retired.

limit.description: Maximum definitions to return. Defaults to 50.

offset.description: Zero-based offset into the filtered newest-first recurrence sequence.

compact.description: Return recurrence identity, schedule, and status fields only. Set false for complete stored task definitions.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

name: task_lifecycle_recurring_suspend
description: Canonical action: recurring suspend (task_lifecycle_recurring_suspend). Suspend an active or draft recurring task definition.

actor_agent_id.description: Architect/operator agent id suspending the recurrence.

authority_basis.description: Authority basis for suspending the recurrence definition.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

name: task_lifecycle_recurring_retire
description: Canonical action: recurring retire (task_lifecycle_recurring_retire). Retire a recurring task definition.

actor_agent_id.description: Architect/operator agent id retiring the recurrence.

authority_basis.description: Authority basis for retiring the recurrence definition.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

name: task_lifecycle_recurring_trigger
description: Canonical action: recurring trigger (task_lifecycle_recurring_trigger). Manually trigger a recurring task definition and create one normal opened task instance.

actor_agent_id.description: Architect/operator agent id triggering the recurrence.

authority_basis.description: Authority basis for manually triggering the recurrence.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

name: task_lifecycle_recurring_runs
description: Canonical action: recurring runs (task_lifecycle_recurring_runs). List generated runs for a recurring task definition.

limit.description: Maximum runs to return. Defaults to 20.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

name: task_lifecycle_set_routing
description: Canonical action: set routing (task_lifecycle_set_routing). Route an opened task to a target role, preferred agent, and/or relative priority without claiming it as that agent. Work Lifecycle requires the declared current task revision for state-dependent mutation.

task_number.description: Task number to route. Must currently be opened.

actor_agent_id.description: Architect/operator agent id performing the routing mutation.

target_role.description: Optional target role. Pass null to clear.

preferred_agent_id.description: Optional preferred agent id. Pass null to clear.

relative_priority.description: Optional relative priority for workboard ranking.

reason.description: Reason/authority basis for the routing change.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

expected_revision.description: Current task aggregate revision; stale state-dependent mutations are refused.

name: task_lifecycle_test_mcp_tool
description: Canonical action: test mcp tool (task_lifecycle_test_mcp_tool). Spawn a fresh MCP server process and invoke a single tool to verify code changes without restarting the live session server.

server_path.description: Path to the MCP server script relative to site root (e.g., "tools/task-lifecycle/task-mcp-server.mjs").

tool_name.description: Tool name to invoke on the spawned server.

timeout_seconds.description: Fresh server invocation timeout in seconds. Defaults to 10, max 300.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

name: task_lifecycle_run_tests
description: Canonical action: run tests (task_lifecycle_run_tests). Run an approved test selector through Test MCP and record structured test evidence on a task. Work Lifecycle requires the declared current task revision for state-dependent mutation.

selector.description: Test selector: task-lifecycle, typed-mcp, operator-surface, or all. Defaults to task-lifecycle.

task_number.description: Task number to attach structured test evidence to.

timeout_seconds.description: Per-test timeout in seconds. Defaults to 120, max 300.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

expected_revision.description: Current task aggregate revision; stale state-dependent mutations are refused.

name: task_lifecycle_guidance
description: Show canonical operating guidance for task lifecycle workflows: ordinary work, blocked work, payloads, review/dependency state, and truthful closeout reporting.

workflow.description: Optional guidance section: ordinary_task, blocked_task, payloads, review_and_dependencies, closeout_truthfulness, or all.

tool.description: Optional lifecycle tool name for tool-specific guidance, such as task_lifecycle_submit_work or task_lifecycle_report_blocked.

detail.description: Compact returns the selected workflow and essential operating guidance. Full returns every decision table, example, recovery rule, and boundary.

name: task_lifecycle_payload_schema
description: Show accepted payload_ref shapes, inline length thresholds, and examples for lifecycle create, finish, closeout, blocked-report, review, and evidence payloads.

tool.description: Optional lifecycle tool name such as task_lifecycle_review or task_lifecycle_finish.

name: task_lifecycle_inspect_range
description: Read-only compact inspection for an explicit task-number range or chapter membership, including closure/evidence posture.

start_task_number.description: First task number in the inclusive range.

end_task_number.description: Last task number in the inclusive range.

chapter_id.description: Optional chapter id to inspect instead of a numeric range.

limit.description: Maximum tasks to return; defaults to 50.

include_body.description: Include task body snippets. Defaults false.

name: task_lifecycle_report_blocked
description: Record exact blockers for claimed work without implying finish/completion. Defaults to deferring the task after writing a blocked report. For long next_action/blocker details, create a payload and call with payload_ref plus top-level task_number and agent_id. Work Lifecycle requires the declared current task revision for state-dependent mutation.

blockers.description: Specific blocker objects, including evidence limits or required external decisions.

next_action.description: Concrete action needed to unblock continuation. Inline strings over the governed inline threshold should be carried in payload_ref.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref carrying long reason, blockers, next_action, or defer. Payload fields are merged with top-level arguments; top-level task_number and agent_id win.

defer.description: When false, record the blocked report without transitioning to deferred. Defaults true.

expected_revision.description: Current task aggregate revision; stale state-dependent mutations are refused.

name: task_lifecycle_chapter_add_task
description: Add an existing task to a named chapter membership list. Defaults to appending after the current maximum order_index. Work Lifecycle requires the declared current task revision for state-dependent mutation.

order_index.description: Optional explicit order index. Used as an insertion point only when append is false.

append.description: When omitted or true, append after the current maximum order_index.

expected_revision.description: Current task aggregate revision; stale state-dependent mutations are refused.

name: task_lifecycle_chapter_show
description: Show task memberships for one chapter, ordered by order_index.

name: task_lifecycle_submit_work
description: Compound governed work submission helper: optionally claim, write execution/verification notes, prove criteria, admit evidence, and finish while preserving primitive lifecycle records and gates. Work Lifecycle requires the declared current task revision for state-dependent mutation.

task_number.description: Task number to submit work for.

execution_notes.description: Substantive authored ## Execution Notes replacement text.

reviewer.description: Optional admitted reviewer agent id or unique reviewer role alias. Ordinary task finish defaults to the first reviewer-capable roster agent, then to the reviewer role, and always generates review-contract dependency work.

changed_files.description: Changed-file evidence for finish. Mutually exclusive with no_files_changed.

no_files_changed.description: Declare no files changed for legitimate no-edit work. Mutually exclusive with changed_files.

claim.description: When true, call task_lifecycle_claim first. Defaults true unless task is already claimed.

prove_criteria.description: When true, call task_lifecycle_prove_criteria after writing notes. Defaults true.

admit_evidence.description: When true, call task_lifecycle_admit_evidence before finish. Defaults true.

finish.description: When true, call task_lifecycle_finish after evidence admission. Defaults true.

resume_existing_work.description: Resume a prior submit_work attempt without rewriting notes or duplicating proof/admission. Reuses the latest report by this agent and the existing substantive task sections, then performs remaining requested lifecycle transitions.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long execution_notes, verification, summary, changed_files, or guard packets. Payload fields are merged with top-level arguments; top-level task_number and agent_id win.

auto_materialize_payload.description: Opt-in fallback for one-call long-field submit_work. When true and payload_ref is absent, the surface creates an immutable payload artifact from companion fields before executing; default false preserves inline length refusal.

authority_basis.description: Required by underlying claim when crossing role/preferred-agent gates.

kind.description: Authority kind: operator_direct_instruction, directed_obligation, or task_owner_handoff.

recovery_truthfulness.description: Passed through to task_lifecycle_finish when recovery truthfulness is triggered.

self_certification.description: Passed through to evidence admission/finish when self-certification gates are triggered.

expected_revision.description: Current task aggregate revision; stale state-dependent mutations are refused.

name: task_lifecycle_evidence_supersede
description: Submit immutable replacement execution evidence for a task already in review. The original report remains preserved; reviewers are directed to the replacement evidence. Work Lifecycle requires the declared current task revision for state-dependent mutation.

task_number.description: In-review task number whose execution evidence changed after submission.

agent_id.description: Agent id submitting the replacement evidence.

supersedes_report_id.description: Existing report id being superseded for review purposes.

artifact_uri.description: Durable URI of the replacement evidence artifact.

summary.description: Short truthful summary of the replacement implementation/evidence.

verification_summary.description: Focused verification performed after the replacement evidence was produced.

changed_files.description: Changed files represented by the replacement evidence. Omit only with no_files_changed=true.

no_files_changed.description: Set true only when the replacement evidence changed no task-owned files.

expected_revision.description: Current task aggregate revision; stale state-dependent mutations are refused.

name: task_lifecycle_dependency_declare
description: Declare that an existing parent task is gated by an existing required task. Optional outcome_contract attaches the required task outcome shape; normal agents should prefer task-native helpers such as submit_work.reviewer when available. Work Lifecycle requires the declared current task revision for state-dependent mutation.

parent_task_number.description: Parent task number that will be blocked by this dependency.

required_task_number.description: Existing required task number that must admit a satisfying outcome.

kind.description: Dependency kind, for example review, verification, operator_decision, or downstream_work.

satisfying_outcomes.description: Outcomes on the required task that satisfy this dependency.

outcome_contract.description: Optional outcome contract for the required task. Fields: outcome_type, allowed_outcomes, satisfying_outcomes, blocking_outcomes, required_fields, capability_requirement.

dependency_id.description: Optional stable dependency id. Defaults to a deterministic id from parent, required task, and kind.

name: mcp_payload_create
description: Create immutable transient MCP payload revision v1 under .ai/tmp/mcp-payloads/workspace.

payload_id.description: Optional stable id segment. Defaults to a generated id.

payload.description: Normal route for clients that can transmit nested objects: the non-empty domain object to store, e.g. {"payload":{"summary":"..."}}. Do not send with payload_json unless payload is exactly {} as a client placeholder.

payload_json.description: String route for clients that cannot transmit free-form nested objects, especially OpenCode: JSON object text, e.g. "{\"summary\":\"...\"}". Authoritative when present; may be accompanied only by payload:{} as a placeholder.

allow_empty.description: Set true only when intentionally creating an empty payload object.

name: mcp_payload_show
description: Show an immutable transient MCP payload revision by ref.

name: mcp_payload_derive
description: Derive a new immutable payload revision by applying an optional object overlay and explicit JSON Pointer deletions.

overlay.description: Optional recursive object overlay. Null remains a value and never means deletion. Do not send with overlay_json unless overlay is exactly {} as a client placeholder.

overlay_json.description: Optional JSON-string overlay route for clients that cannot transmit free-form nested objects. Authoritative when present; may be accompanied only by overlay:{} as a placeholder.

delete_paths.description: Optional RFC 6901-encoded object-field paths to delete after applying the overlay, e.g. ["/preferred_role", "/constraints/model"]. Array traversal is not supported. At least one overlay route or delete path is required.

name: mcp_payload_validate
description: Validate that a payload ref exists, is well-formed, and is within size limits.

name: mcp_output_show
description: Read a materialized MCP output ref with offset/limit paging.

ref.description: Materialized output ref, e.g. mcp_output:<id>. Alias: output_ref.

offset.description: Character offset into the materialized JSON output.

limit.description: Maximum output characters to return; the transport hard-caps this value.

timeout_ms.description: Strict upper bound for reading and validating the materialized output file.
